howItWorks.title: How batch processing works
steps: Upload as many files as you want to process.
Click Start batch — each file is processed independently and downloadable as soon as it's ready.

items.q: Does one failed file stop the whole batch?
items.a: No. Each file is its own independent job — if one fails, the rest keep processing and remain downloadable individually.

items.q: Can I use any tool for batch processing?
items.a: Batch mode currently supports a curated set of operations that don't need any extra input beyond the file itself. Tools that need custom input per file, like a specific watermark's text, aren't included yet.

items.q: Do batch jobs count against my daily limit?
items.a: Yes — each file processed is one operation, counted the same way as using that tool normally.

items.q: Will my files be kept private?
items.a: Yes. Every file is processed securely and automatically deleted after a short retention period, the same as any other tool.
